verdict.rationale: Appwrite's databases docs say outright that developers can "store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features." Its managed PostgreSQL offering also supports installing pgvector, a first-party, hosted path to vector search. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the vector API (index types, distance metrics, query syntax, limits), whether vectors work in the managed TablesDB API or only via dedicated Postgres, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
